citations.assessment: Bekhorot expressly gives the patronymic in the redemption narrative.

holds.reason: The companion entry expressly repeats inability to locate the claimed father-son relation. The Bavli names Rav Haviva in Moed Katan with no patronymic.

notes.text: Bekhorot supports the patronymic for Rav Aha. The two explicit examination holds remain, including Ravna in the checked Shabbat witness and the uncollated Rif variant.
